Changes (PR #120): `ship_pr.py` now runs the lint of `agent.toml` (ruff and Biome), also with `--tested`. Before, a Biome error went to CI red, the PR stalled and a later run took it over. `health.py` now finds the report of a taken-over run by its `branch` field: the causes change from "no report 4" to "after the report 3, no report 1".
Expect: fewer red CI runs on TypeScript PRs, and fewer takeovers after the report. Measure after 50 PRs past #120.
Not changed: the 48 % read phase. All projects in this period are young (the first 41 merges in 2.3 h), so look at it again at the next review with more data. The 17 PNG files flagged by "Files that do not belong in git" are app icons and guide screenshots: that is a false alarm of `health.py`.
